title: Turn relay
description: An illuminated connection follows the handoff between a typed message and an interruptible reply.
useCase: Make conversation ownership visible while a voice or text assistant prepares and delivers a response.
interaction: Send the prepared phrase or write your own, then interrupt a reply or send another message
reducedMotion: Stops waveform and thinking loops, removes handoff movement and makes visual state changes immediate. The explicitly initiated reply still progresses through its words.
limitations: Silent local text simulation with three authored replies. No microphone, speech recognition, model connection or network request. Connect actual service events before representing a live voice conversation. Host pause and document hiding suspend the elapsed-time clock.
look: Dark navy gradient card on pale blue with two round speaker nodes on a thin vertical line above a dark composer and pale-blue send key.
motion: Sending slides a streak down the connector in 440 ms, lighting the assistant node; dots pulse while thinking, then reply words brighten 220 ms apart as level bars oscillate.
adapt: `phase` drives the `connection` streak, node glow and `levels` bars via `data-phase` CSS; the interval effect holds thinking for 850 ms, then reveals words every 220 ms through `shown`. Swap `REPLIES` and that timer for real agent events; keep `interrupt`.
